entries.title: Kingdoms and Castles
entries.definitive_edition: Kingdoms and Castles on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is part of the original PC release family, has current Steam/GOG support, and is the best capture/settings route. Xbox and PlayStation ports are valid console routes but add no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam or GOG. Use Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, PS4, or PS5 only if a console route is preferred.

all_releases.reason: primary: original release family and best capture/settings route.
